addressed_findings.rationale: Pure reviewChangeSummary enumerates exact sent fields with saved/proposed values, null and empty clears. Organization save submits only parent/deadline/order; labels match actual scope. Raw notes are rendered only as text.
Parent options always retain current/proposed parent even when dropped, without manufacturing a null patch during unrelated title save.
Host display context/state types are owned by pure display model; ports imports/re-exports them. Dependency enforcement remains enabled and unused DOM test binding removed.
Mutation invoker identity is captured before entering busy/render, then restored to the newly keyed row control after cancel; vanished controls retain existing fallback.

limitations: Root/integrator owns full pnpm check/build and independent final review.
Local generated DOM and browser evidence do not prove hosted ChatGPT/D1/trusted authentication acceptance.
